from mavsdk.mission import MissionPlan

# Define sweep waypoints: 3 parallel passes + center hold
waypoints = [
    # Pass 1: West edge, north pass
    (-150, -50, 10),
    (-150, 50, 10),
    # Pass 2: Center, south pass
    (-100, 50, 10),
    (-100, -50, 10),
    # Pass 3: East edge, north pass
    (-50, -50, 10),
    (-50, 50, 10),
    # Return to center for holdover
    (-100, 0, 10),
]

items = []
for i, (e, n, u) in enumerate(waypoints):
    g = await world_to_geo(east=e, north=n, up=u)
    # Last waypoint (center) is fly-through for holdover
    is_last = (i == len(waypoints) - 1)
    items.append(mission_item(
        latitude_deg=g.latitude_deg,
        longitude_deg=g.longitude_deg,
        relative_altitude_m=u,
        speed_m_s=3,
        is_fly_through=(not is_last)  # Fly through all except final center
    ))

await drone.mission.upload_mission(MissionPlan(items))
await arm_and_start()

async for p in drone.mission.mission_progress():
    log(f'Waypoint {p.current}/{p.total}')
    if p.current == p.total:
        break

log('Holding at block center')

await asyncio.sleep(10)
